title: Pure Gladiator Beast
summary: Pure Gladiator Beast contact Fusion and tag-team combo build, centering the ancient arena fighters alongside modern 2025 legacy support. The deck tags monsters in and out of the Deck to trigger searches, revives, and pops, climbing into Link starters like Test Panther and Dareios before deploying colossal Contact Fusion bosses like Claudius and Domitianus.

summary.title: Starters
points: Gladiator Beast Gistel reveals itself and another Gladiator Beast in hand to Special Summon both to the field, and when Special Summoned by a Gladiator Beast card, searches a Gladiator Beast Spell or Trap.

Flavian - Colosseum of the Gladiator Beasts discards 1 card to search any Gladiator Beast monster from your Deck, summons a Gladiator Beast from the Deck when an attack is declared, and Sets a Gladiator Beast Trap directly from your Deck.
Gladiator Proving Ground adds a Level 4 or lower Gladiator Beast monster from your Deck to your hand.

Gladiator Rejection grants your Gladiator Beasts targeting immunity outside the Battle Phase and summons a differently named Gladiator Beast from the Deck whenever one is Special Summoned from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Gistel + Gladiator Beast
steps: Activate Gistel's effect in hand, revealing Gistel and another Gladiator Beast (such as Bestiari or Darius) to Special Summon both.
Link Summon Test Panther using the two Gladiator Beasts.
Trigger Test Panther to add Gladiator Beast's Comeback (or Gladiator Rejection) from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Test Panther's second effect: shuffle a Gladiator Beast into the Deck to Special Summon Gladiator Beast Augustus directly from your Deck.
Augustus triggers to Special Summon a Gladiator Beast from hand, enabling contact Fusion into Gladiator Beast Tamer Editor or Gyzarus.

summary.title: Bosses & Contact Fusions
points: Gladiator Beast Claudius is summoned by shuffling 5 Gladiator Beasts from your field or GY into the Deck: it grants an extra Battle Phase and Special Summons a Gladiator Beast Fusion ignoring summoning conditions whenever the opponent activates a monster effect.
Gladiator Beast Domitianus (Level 10) negates an opponent's monster effect as a Quick Effect and chooses the attack targets for the opponent's attacks.
Gladiator Beast Heraklinos discards 1 card to negate the activation of a Spell or Trap Card and destroy it, without a once-per-turn restriction.
Gladiator Beast Gyzarus shuffles Bestiari and a Gladiator Beast into the Deck to destroy up to 2 cards on the field upon arrival.
Gladiator Beast Tamer Editor requires two Level 5 or higher Gladiator Beasts: once per turn, it cheats any Gladiator Beast Fusion Monster directly out of the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Links & Tagging
points: Gladiator Beast Dareios (Link-2) Special Summons a Gladiator Beast from your hand or GY, or summons one from your Deck if the opponent controls a monster, and protects your Gladiator Beasts from battle destruction during the opponent's turn.
Test Panther and Gladiator Beast Dragases provide battle-free tag-outs and attack protection.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Gladiator Beast War Chariot is an archetype Counter Trap that negates an Effect Monster's activation and destroys it while you control a face-up Gladiator Beast.
Gladiator Beast United performs a contact Fusion during the Battle Phase by shuffling materials from hand, field, or GY into the Deck.
Gladiator Beast Charge destroys face-up cards on the field up to the number of differently named Gladiator Beasts you control.
Gladiator Beast's Comeback revives a Gladiator Beast with battle destruction immunity.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Tri-Brigade, Speedroid, and X-Saber hybrid packages are excluded to focus on a pure Gladiator Beast strategy.
